title: Pharmacy safety operations
description: Control medicine lots, recalls, prescription evidence, and professional authorizations from one audited workspace.

context.approvalAuthorizationRecoveryDescription: Other safety operations remain available. An administrator must revoke and recreate the affected authorization; any still-valid prescription linked to it must then be explicitly re-approved.
context.approvalKeyRecoveryDescription: Other safety operations remain available. Do not revoke valid authorizations: restore the pharmacy evidence key or restart the protected local service before approvals resume.

common.searchMedicinePlaceholder: Name, active ingredient, generic, code, or registration

lots.siteRequiredDescription: Choose the site whose physical medicine lots you need to inspect.
lots.selectionDescription: Review exact on-hand custody at {{site}} before changing any safety state.
lots.noProducts: No active lot-tracked medicines are configured yet.
lots.noLots: This medicine has no lot history at the current site.
lots.actionsDescription: Every action is server-validated, versioned, and recorded in the immutable lot ledger.
lots.reasonPlaceholder: Describe the incident, inspection, decision, or destruction record.
lots.reasonHelp: Use a concrete operational reason. A recall remains dominant until it is closed explicitly.
lots.releaseBlockedByRecall: Close every active recall that covers this lot before attempting a release.
lots.destroyHelp: Destruction permanently removes this exact quantity from the lot and reconciles site and business stock.

toast.error: Unable to update the medicine lot

recalls.createDescription: Block every matching lot immediately by product, exact lot, provider, or sanitary registration.
recalls.noMedicines: No matching pharmacy medicines were found.
recalls.lotLoadError: Unable to load the medicine lots.
recalls.noLots: No lots were found for this medicine at the selected site.
recalls.noProviders: No matching active providers were found.
recalls.reasonPlaceholder: Record the official notice, supplier alert, quality incident, or other verified cause. Do not include patient data.
recalls.listDescription: Open a recall to inspect affected physical lots and completed sales.
recalls.emptyDescription: New recall events will appear here with their exact scope and blocked lots.
recalls.affectedSalesPrivacy: Customer identity is visible only to administrators in this recall workflow. Do not export or share it without authorization.
recalls.affectedSalesPrivacyRestricted: Customer identity is redacted for managers. An administrator must review authorized contact details when follow-up is required.
recalls.noAffectedSales: No completed sale consumed these exact lots.
recalls.closeWarning: Closing the recall does not release any lot. Each lot stays blocked until a separate documented release.

toast.releaseRequired: Affected lots remain blocked until each one is released explicitly.

evidence.title: Prescription evidence review
evidence.description: Approve only evidence that is current, complete, and supported by an effective professional authorization. The server revalidates policy at approval and sale time.
evidence.privacyNote: This list intentionally omits prescription references, prescriber credentials, buyer documents, and notes. Sensitive values remain sealed and are never redisplayed.
evidence.approvalUnavailable: Your user does not have an effective professional authorization for this site and business date. You can review or revoke evidence, but an authorized employee must approve it.
evidence.emptyDescription: Evidence recorded during checkout will appear here for controlled review.

authorizations.createDescription: Bind an employee, effective dates, site scope, country, and verified credential. The credential is sealed and cannot be viewed again.
authorizations.countryHelp: The current tenant policy country is authoritative and cannot be overridden here.
authorizations.credentialHelp: Enter the verified value once. It is encrypted and omitted from every list response.
authorizations.invalidDates: The end date cannot be before the start date.
authorizations.adminOnly: Managers can review authorization status. Only administrators can register or revoke professional credentials.
authorizations.listDescription: Review current and revoked authorization scopes without exposing credential secrets.
authorizations.emptyDescription: An administrator must register an effective authorization before prescription evidence can be approved.

toast.error: Unable to update the professional authorization

limits.title: Operational support, not regulatory certification
limits.description: Puntovivo enforces the configured policy and custody evidence. Legal review, registry validation, controlled-medicine enablement, temperature hardware, and country certification remain external gates.

product.enabled: Manage this product as a medicine
product.enabledHelp: Medicine products always use stock and lot traceability. Prescription policy is evaluated again at checkout.
product.profileLocked: Regulated history or active operations protect this medicine profile. Fields that would detach that history remain locked.
product.coldChainLocked: Clear active stock and open drafts before changing cold-chain handling. Existing units cannot gain or lose that custody claim silently.
product.disabled: This is an ordinary retail product
product.disabledHelp: Enable medicine management only for products that require pharmacy policy and lot custody.
product.controlledBlocked: Controlled medicines remain blocked from sale until a legally reviewed country policy explicitly enables them.
product.prescriptionNotice: Checkout requires an identified customer, valid prescription evidence, and approval by a currently authorized professional.

identity.title: Medicine identity
identity.description: Searchable non-clinical catalog data. Puntovivo does not recommend treatments or substitutions.

regulatory.title: Regulatory record
regulatory.description: Classification and market authorization used by the effective country policy.

storage.title: Storage and custody
storage.description: Operational handling instructions for every received lot.

fields.sanitaryRegistrationHelp: Required by the Colombia adapter before any sale can complete.
fields.requiresColdChainHelp: A reported temperature excursion quarantines the exact lot. Sensor integration remains external.

checkout.title: Pharmacy policy
checkout.checking: Checking medicine policy and prescription evidence…
checkout.unavailable: Medicine policy could not be verified. Checkout stays blocked until the authoritative read succeeds.
checkout.quantityRequired: Authorized quantity required for this sale: {{quantity}}
checkout.noEvidence: No approved evidence has enough remaining quantity. Record or approve a prescription before charging.
checkout.customerRequired: Select an active customer before using prescription evidence.
checkout.selectionCovered: The selected evidence already covers this medicine. Deselect it before choosing a different record.
checkout.otcReady: No prescription evidence is required for this OTC medicine.
checkout.invalidDates: The prescription expiry cannot be before its start date.
checkout.awaitingProfessionalApproval: The evidence is pending approval by an employee with an effective professional authorization. Refresh this section after approval.
checkout.approvalRecordedAwaitingRefresh: Approval was recorded. Refresh evidence if it does not appear yet.
checkout.reapprovalRequired: This prescription is still valid, but its previous professional approval is no longer usable.
checkout.approvedAndSelected: Evidence approved and selected for this sale
checkout.notReady: Complete every medicine requirement before confirming payment.
checkout.ready: Medicine policy and selected evidence are ready for atomic checkout.
